words.gloss: in the worship of a deity
in the worship of a deity (editors' doubt mark)
places of worship and of arrival

hindi: देवता की पूजा के लिए की जाने वाली यात्रा में शत्रु के, भक्ति के कारण, पूजा करने और पहुँचने के अनेक स्थान होते हैं।
english: In a procession for the worship of a deity the enemy has, out of devotion, many places of worship and of arrival.

text_flags.why: the e-text's member split daiva.tejyā does not yield a word; the print form daivatejyāyāṃ resolves as daivata + ijyāyām (worship of a deity); the editors' doubt mark offers devatā.ijyāyāṃ with the same sense

notes: The bracketed token is the editors' doubt mark, not part of the sentence; it is split as the reading it proposes. 'yātrā' may be a religious procession or the king's journey to a festival.
lines_deva: दैव.तेज्यायां (देवता.इज्यायां?) यात्रायाम् अमित्रस्य बहूनि पूजा.आगम.स्थानानि भक्तितः
lines_iast: daiva.tejyāyāṃ (devatā.ijyāyāṃ?) yātrāyām amitrasya bahūni pūjā.āgama.sthānāni bhaktitaḥ

hindi: वहाँ उसके विरुद्ध युक्ति रचे।
english: There he should set up a contrivance against him.
lines_deva: तत्र-अस्य योगम् उब्जयेत्
lines_iast: tatra-asya yogam ubjayet

words.gloss: of him who has entered the temple
by the release of a machine

hindi: जब वह देवता के मन्दिर में प्रवेश कर चुका हो, तब यन्त्र छोड़कर ऊपर से उस पर गुप्त दीवार अथवा शिला गिरवाए।
english: When he has entered the temple, he should, by releasing a machine, make a hidden wall or a stone fall on him from above.
lines_deva: देवता.गृह.प्रविष्टस्य-उपरि यन्त्र.मोक्षणेन गूढ.भित्तिं शिलां वा पातयेत्
lines_iast: devatā.gṛha.praviṣṭasya-upari yantra.mokṣaṇena gūḍha.bhittiṃ śilāṃ vā pātayet

words.gloss: a shower of stones and weapons

hindi: ऊपरी कक्ष से शिलाओं और शस्त्रों की वर्षा, अथवा गिराया हुआ किवाड़, अथवा दीवार में लगा या एक सिरे से बँधा हुआ परिघ उस पर छोड़े।
english: He should let loose from the topmost chamber a shower of stones and weapons, or a door-panel made to fall down, or a bar set in the wall or fastened at one end.
lines_deva: शिला.शस्त्र.वर्षम् उत्तम.आगारात्, कपाटम् अवपातितं वा, भित्ति.प्रणिहितम् एक.देश.बद्धं वा परिघं मोक्षयेत्
lines_iast: śilā.śastra.varṣam uttama.āgārāt, kapāṭam avapātitaṃ vā, bhitti.praṇihitam eka.deśa.baddhaṃ vā parighaṃ mokṣayet

words.gloss: the deity's body, banner and weapons
words.gram: n. acc. pl., tat-puruṣa with dvandva

hindi: अथवा देवता का शरीर, ध्वज या आयुध ऊपर से उस पर गिरवाए।
english: Or he should make the deity's body, banner or weapons fall on him from above.
notes: devatā-deha: the body (limbs) of the deity's image.
lines_deva: देवता.देह.ध्वज.प्रहरणानि वा-अस्य-उपरिष्टात् पातयेत्
lines_iast: devatā.deha.dhvaja.praharaṇāni vā-asya-upariṣṭāt pātayet

words.gloss: on the grounds where he stands, sits and walks
words.gram: f. loc. pl., tat-puruṣa with dvandva

words.gloss: by a sprinkling of scented water
by an offering of flowers and powder

hindi: अथवा उसके खड़े होने, बैठने और चलने के स्थानों पर गोबर के लेप से, सुगन्धित जल के छिड़काव से, अथवा फूलों और चूर्ण के उपहार से विष फैलाए।
english: Or on the grounds where he stands, sits and walks he should spread poison by a plaster of cow-dung, by a sprinkling of scented water, or by an offering of flowers and powder.
notes: rasa here = poison, as throughout this chapter. puṣpa-cūrṇa could be 'flower-powder' (one item) or 'flowers and powder'.
lines_deva: स्थान.आसन.गमन.भूमिषु वा-अस्य गो.मय.प्रदेहेन गन्ध.उदक.प्रसेकेन वा रसम् अतिचारयेत्, पुष्प.चूर्ण.उपहारेण वा
lines_iast: sthāna.āsana.gamana.bhūmiṣu vā-asya go.maya.pradehena gandha.udaka.prasekena vā rasam aticārayet, puṣpa.cūrṇa.upahāreṇa vā

hindi: अथवा सुगन्ध से ढका हुआ तीक्ष्ण धुआँ उस तक पहुँचाए।
english: Or he should convey to him a pungent smoke concealed by perfume.
lines_deva: गन्ध.प्रतिच्छन्नं वा-अस्य तीक्ष्णं धूमम् अतिनयेत्
lines_iast: gandha.praticchannaṃ vā-asya tīkṣṇaṃ dhūmam atinayet

words.gloss: whose floor is held by a machine

hindi: अथवा शय्या या आसन के नीचे, जिसका तल यन्त्र से बँधा हो ऐसे शूलों के कूप या गड्ढे में, कील छोड़कर उसे गिरा दे।
english: Or, with a pit of stakes or a pitfall below the bed or seat, its floor held by a machine, he should make him fall in by releasing a pin.
notes: yantra-baddha-tala taken as a bahuvrīhi qualifying the pit (its floor held by a mechanism), as in the Hindi; the accusative also allows it to qualify enam.
lines_deva: शूलकूपम् अवपातनं वा शयन.आसनस्य-अधस्ताद् यन्त्र.बद्ध.तलम् एनं कील.मोक्षणेन प्रवेशयेत्
lines_iast: śūlakūpam avapātanaṃ vā śayana.āsanasya-adhastād yantra.baddha.talam enaṃ kīla.mokṣaṇena praveśayet

hindi: अथवा शत्रु के निकट आ जाने पर, जनपद से घेरा सह सकने योग्य लोगों को ले आए।
english: Or when the enemy is near, he should bring over from the country the people able to bear a siege.
lines_deva: प्रत्यासन्ने वा-अमित्रे जन.पदाज् जनम् अवरोध.क्षमम् अतिनयेत्
lines_iast: pratyāsanne vā-amitre jana.padāj janam avarodha.kṣamam atinayet

hindi: और दुर्ग से घेरा न सह सकने वाले लोगों को हटा दे, अथवा उन्हें फिर से लिये जा सकने वाले शत्रु-प्रदेश में भेज दे।
english: And he should remove from the fort those unable to bear a siege, or send them to an enemy territory that is to be taken back.
lines_deva: दुर्गाच् च-अनवरोध.क्षमम् अपनयेत्, प्रत्यादेयम् अरि.विषयं वा प्रेषयेत्
lines_iast: durgāc ca-anavarodha.kṣamam apanayet, pratyādeyam ari.viṣayaṃ vā preṣayet

words.gloss: in mountain, forest and river forts
words.gram: n. loc. pl., tat-puruṣa with dvandva

words.gloss: in those separated by a wilderness
taken charge of by a son or brother

hindi: और एक स्थान पर एकत्र जनपद के लोगों को पर्वत, वन या नदी के दुर्गों में, अथवा जंगल से अलग किये हुए स्थानों में, पुत्र या भाई की देख-रेख में बसाए।
english: And he should settle the country people, gathered in one place, in mountain, forest or river forts, or in places separated by a wilderness, under the charge of a son or brother.
lines_deva: जन.पदं च-एकस्थं शैल.वन.नदी.दुर्गेष्व् अटवी.व्यवहितेषु वा पुत्र.भ्रातृ.परिगृहीतं स्थापयेत्
lines_iast: jana.padaṃ ca-ekasthaṃ śaila.vana.nadī.durgeṣv aṭavī.vyavahiteṣu vā putra.bhrātṛ.parigṛhītaṃ sthāpayet

words.gloss: in (the section on) the conduct of one submitting with his army

hindi: घेरे के कारण सेना सहित समर्पण करने वाले राजा के आचरण के प्रकरण में समझाए जा चुके हैं।
english: The causes of a siege have been explained in the section on the conduct of one submitting with his army.
lines_deva: उपरोध.हेतवो दण्ड.उपनत.वृत्ते व्याख्याताः
lines_iast: uparodha.hetavo daṇḍa.upanata.vṛtte vyākhyātāḥ

hindi: एक योजन तक घास और लकड़ी जलवा दे।
english: He should have grass and wood burnt for up to a yojana.
lines_deva: तृण.काष्ठम् आ.योजनाद् दाहयेत्
lines_iast: tṛṇa.kāṣṭham ā.yojanād dāhayet

hindi: और जलाशयों को दूषित कर दे और उन्हें बहा दे।
english: And he should contaminate the waters and drain them away.
lines_deva: उदकानि च दूषयेत्, अवस्रावयेच् च
lines_iast: udakāni ca dūṣayet, avasrāvayec ca

words.gloss: wells, concealed traps, pitfalls and thorny barriers

hindi: और बाहर कुएँ, छिपे हुए फन्दे, गड्ढे और काँटेदार अवरोध बनवाए।
english: And outside he should set up wells, concealed traps, pitfalls and thorny barriers.
notes: The compound ends in the feminine kaṇṭakinī (thorny plants or thorn-barriers), so the whole dvandva is feminine plural.
lines_deva: कूप.कूट.अवपात.कण्टकिनीश् च बहिर् उब्जयेत्
lines_iast: kūpa.kūṭa.avapāta.kaṇṭakinīś ca bahir ubjayet

words.gloss: the chiefs in charge of stores

hindi: शत्रु के स्थान तक अनेक मुखों वाली सुरंग बनाकर उसके भण्डारों के प्रमुखों को, अथवा शत्रु को ही, उठवा ले।
english: Having made a tunnel with many openings to the enemy's position, he should have the chiefs in charge of stores carried off, or the enemy himself.
notes: nicaya-mukhyān could also be 'the principal stores' (mukhya adjectival); 'chiefs in charge of stores' is one reading.
lines_deva: सुरुङ्गाम् अमित्र.स्थाने बहु.मुखीं कृत्वा निचय.मुख्यान् अभिहारयेत्, अमित्रं वा
lines_iast: suruṅgām amitra.sthāne bahu.mukhīṃ kṛtvā nicaya.mukhyān abhihārayet, amitraṃ vā

hindi: अथवा जब शत्रु सुरंग का प्रयोग करे, तब जल तक पहुँचने वाली खाई खुदवाए, अथवा प्राकार के साथ-साथ कुओं की पंक्ति।
english: Or when a tunnel is employed by the enemy, he should have a moat dug reaching down to water, or a row of wells along the rampart.
notes: kūpa-śālā: a hall or series of wells; anusālam from sāla 'rampart'.
lines_deva: पर.प्रयुक्तायां वा सुरुङ्गायां परिखाम् उदक.अन्तिकीं खानयेत्, कूप.शालाम् अनुसालं वा
lines_iast: para.prayuktāyāṃ vā suruṅgāyāṃ parikhām udaka.antikīṃ khānayet, kūpa.śālām anusālaṃ vā

hindi: खुदाई का पता लगाने के लिए सन्देह के स्थानों पर जल के घड़े अथवा काँसे के पात्र रखवाए।
english: He should place water-jars or bell-metal vessels at suspected places for the detection of digging.
lines_deva: तोय.कुम्भान् कांस्य.भाण्डानि वा शङ्का.स्थानेषु स्थापयेत् खात.अभिज्ञान.अर्थम्
lines_iast: toya.kumbhān kāṃsya.bhāṇḍāni vā śaṅkā.sthāneṣu sthāpayet khāta.abhijñāna.artham

hindi: सुरंग का मार्ग ज्ञात हो जाने पर प्रतिसुरंग बनवाए।
english: When the course of the tunnel is known, he should have a counter-tunnel made.
lines_deva: ज्ञाते सुरुङ्गा.पथे प्रतिसुरुङ्गां कारयेत्
lines_iast: jñāte suruṅgā.pathe pratisuruṅgāṃ kārayet

hindi: बीच में तोड़कर उसमें धुआँ अथवा जल भर दे।
english: Having broken through in the middle, he should let in smoke or water.
lines_deva: मध्ये भित्त्वा धूमम् उदकं वा प्रयच्छेत्
lines_iast: madhye bhittvā dhūmam udakaṃ vā prayacchet

hindi: अथवा दुर्ग की रक्षा का प्रबन्ध करके, मूल स्थान में किसी उत्तराधिकारी को रखकर, शत्रु की विपरीत दिशा में चला जाए; अथवा वहाँ जाए जहाँ से वह मित्रों, बन्धुओं या वनवासी सरदारों से, अथवा शत्रु के बलवान शत्रुओं या दूष्यों से मिल सके; अथवा जहाँ जाकर वह शत्रु को उसके मित्रों से अलग कर सके, उसका पिछला भाग पकड़ सके, उससे उसका राज्य छिनवा सके, अथवा उसकी रसद, सहायक सेना और चारा-टोलियों को रोक सके; अथवा जहाँ से वह जुआरी की तरह एक दाँव से उस पर प्रहार कर सके; अथवा जहाँ से वह अपने राज्य की रक्षा कर सके या अपने मूल की वृद्धि कर सके।
english: Or, having provided for the defence of the fort and placed an heir at the base, he should go in the direction opposite to the enemy; or go whence he might join allies, kinsmen or forest chiefs, or the enemy's powerful enemies or treasonable men; or whence, having gone, he might separate the enemy from his allies, seize his rear, make him lose his kingdom, or stop his supplies, reinforcements and foraging parties; or whence he might be able, like a dice-player, to strike at him with a throw; or whence he might protect his own kingdom or bring about an increase of his base.
notes: mūla = the base, the home territory. āsāra here = reinforcements (glossary: reinforcer). ākṣikavad apakṣepeṇa: 'with a throw (of the dice) like a gambler', i.e. a sudden decisive stroke; the exact image is uncertain.
lines_deva: प्रतिविहित.दुर्गो वा मूले दायादं कृत्वा प्रतिलोमाम् अस्य दिशं गच्छेत्, यतो वा मित्रैर् बन्धुभिर् आटविकैर् वा संसृज्येत परस्य-अमित्रैर् दूष्यैर् वा महद्भिः, यतो वा गतो ऽस्य मित्रैर् वियोगं कुर्यात् पार्ष्णिं वा गृह्णीयात् राज्यं वा-अस्य हारयेत् वीवध.आसार.प्रसारान् वा वारयेत्, यतो वा शक्नुयाद् आक्षिकवद् अपक्षेपेण-अस्य प्रहर्तुम्, यतो वा स्वं राज्यं त्रायेत मूलस्य-उपचयं वा कुर्यात्
lines_iast: prativihita.durgo vā mūle dāyādaṃ kṛtvā pratilomām asya diśaṃ gacchet, yato vā mitrair bandhubhir āṭavikair vā saṃsṛjyeta parasya-amitrair dūṣyair vā mahadbhiḥ, yato vā gato 'sya mitrair viyogaṃ kuryāt pārṣṇiṃ vā gṛhṇīyāt rājyaṃ vā-asya hārayet vīvadha.āsāra.prasārān vā vārayet, yato vā śaknuyād ākṣikavad apakṣepeṇa-asya prahartum, yato vā svaṃ rājyaṃ trāyeta mūlasya-upacayaṃ vā kuryāt

hindi: अथवा वहाँ जाए जहाँ से वह मनचाही सन्धि प्राप्त कर सके।
english: Or he should go to that place from which he might obtain the peace he desires.
lines_deva: यतः सन्धिम् अभिप्रेतं लभेत ततो वा गच्छेत्
lines_iast: yataḥ sandhim abhipretaṃ labheta tato vā gacchet

words.gloss: those who set out with him
a force with a strong core

words.gram: m. acc. sg., caus. ppp. pra-√vas

hindi: अथवा उसके साथ निकले हुए लोग सन्देश भेजें: "यह तुम्हारा शत्रु हमारे हाथ में आ गया है; व्यापार या किसी अपकार का बहाना करके सोना और भीतर से सार-युक्त सेना भेजो, जिसे हम इसे बँधा हुआ या मारा हुआ सौंप दें।"
english: Or those who set out with him should send word: "This enemy of yours has come into our hands; on the pretext of merchandise or of an injury, send gold and a force with a strong core, to which we may hand him over, bound or put to death."
notes: pravāsita, literally 'sent into exile', is used in the text for 'put to death'; 'exiled' is also possible. asya: the message goes to the besieging enemy.
lines_deva: सह.प्रस्थायिनो वा-अस्य प्रेषयेयुः "अयं ते शत्रुर् अस्माकं हस्त.गतः, पण्यं विप्रकारं वा-अपदिश्य हिरण्यम् अन्तः.सार.बलं च प्रेषय यस्य-एनम् अर्पयेम बद्धं प्रवासितं वा" इति
lines_iast: saha.prasthāyino vā-asya preṣayeyuḥ "ayaṃ te śatrur asmākaṃ hasta.gataḥ, paṇyaṃ viprakāraṃ vā-apadiśya hiraṇyam antaḥ.sāra.balaṃ ca preṣaya yasya-enam arpayema baddhaṃ pravāsitaṃ vā" iti

hindi: उसके मान लेने पर वह सोना और सार-सेना ले ले।
english: When this is agreed, he should take the gold and the picked force.
lines_deva: प्रतिपन्ने हिरण्यं सार.बलं च-आददीत
lines_iast: pratipanne hiraṇyaṃ sāra.balaṃ ca-ādadīta

hindi: अथवा अन्तपाल दुर्ग सौंपने के बहाने शत्रु-सेना के एक भाग को भीतर ले जाकर, विश्वास में आ जाने पर, उसका वध करवा दे।
english: Or the frontier officer, on the pretext of handing over a fort, having led a part of the enemy's army inside, should have it killed when it has become trusting.
lines_deva: अन्त.पालो वा दुर्ग.सम्प्रदाने बल.एक.देशम् अतिनीय विश्वस्तं घातयेत्
lines_iast: anta.pālo vā durga.sampradāne bala.eka.deśam atinīya viśvastaṃ ghātayet

hindi: अथवा एक स्थान पर एकत्र जनपद के लोगों को मारने के लिए शत्रु-सेना को बुलाए।
english: Or he should invite the enemy's army to kill the country people gathered in one place.
lines_deva: जन.पदम् एकस्थं वा घातयितुम् अमित्र.अनीकम् आवाहयेत्
lines_iast: jana.padam ekasthaṃ vā ghātayitum amitra.anīkam āvāhayet

hindi: उसे घिरे हुए प्रदेश में ले जाकर, विश्वास में आ जाने पर, मरवा दे।
english: Having led it into an enclosed region, he should have it killed when it has become trusting.
lines_deva: तद् अवरुद्ध.देशम् अतिनीय विश्वस्तं घातयेत्
lines_iast: tad avaruddha.deśam atinīya viśvastaṃ ghātayet

words.gloss: one in the guise of a friend

hindi: अथवा मित्र का रूप धारण किया हुआ व्यक्ति बाहर वाले शत्रु को सन्देश भेजे: "इस दुर्ग में अनाज, तेल, क्षार या नमक समाप्त हो गया है; वह अमुक स्थान पर अमुक समय भीतर पहुँचेगा; उसे पकड़ लो।"
english: Or one in the guise of a friend should send word to the one outside: "Grain, oils, sugar or salt are exhausted in this fort; it will come in at such a place and time; seize it."
notes: pravekṣyati is active ('will enter'); rendered 'will be brought in' for the supplies. kṣāra = sugar (the kṣāra-varga of 2.15), the usual sense in the text's supply lists; Hindi keeps क्षार.
lines_deva: मित्र.व्यञ्जनो वा बाह्यस्य प्रेषयेत् "क्षीणम् अस्मिन् दुर्गे धान्यं स्नेहाः क्षारो लवणं वा, तद् अमुष्मिन् देशे काले च प्रवेक्ष्यति, तद् उपगृहाण" इति
lines_iast: mitra.vyañjano vā bāhyasya preṣayet "kṣīṇam asmin durge dhānyaṃ snehāḥ kṣāro lavaṇaṃ vā, tad amuṣmin deśe kāle ca pravekṣyati, tad upagṛhāṇa" iti

words.gloss: treasonable men, enemies and forest chiefs

hindi: तब दूष्य, शत्रु और वनवासी सरदार, अथवा अन्य मरने के लिए छोड़े हुए लोग, विष-मिला अनाज, तेल, क्षार या नमक भीतर पहुँचाएँ।
english: Then treasonable men, enemies and forest chiefs, or others given up to death, should bring in grain, oil, sugar or salt mixed with poison.
notes: abhityakta: men marked out for death, desperadoes in the text's usage.
lines_deva: ततो रस.विद्धं धान्यं स्नेहं क्षारं लवणं वा दूष्य.अमित्र.आटविकाः प्रवेशयेयुः, अन्ये वा-अभित्यक्ताः
lines_iast: tato rasa.viddhaṃ dhānyaṃ snehaṃ kṣāraṃ lavaṇaṃ vā dūṣya.amitra.āṭavikāḥ praveśayeyuḥ, anye vā-abhityaktāḥ

words.gloss: the seizing of all goods and supplies

hindi: इसी से सभी प्रकार के सामान और रसद को पकड़वाना समझाया गया है।
english: By this the seizing of all goods and supplies is explained.
lines_deva: तेन सर्व.भाण्ड.वीवध.ग्रहणं व्याख्यातम्
lines_iast: tena sarva.bhāṇḍa.vīvadha.grahaṇaṃ vyākhyātam

words.gram: m. nom. sg., pres. part. vi-√lamb

hindi: अथवा सन्धि करके उसे सोने का एक भाग दे और शेष में विलम्ब करता रहे।
english: Or, having made peace, he should give him a part of the gold, delaying over the rest.
lines_deva: सन्धिं वा कृत्वा हिरण्य.एक.देशम् अस्मै दद्यात्, विलम्बमानः शेषम्
lines_iast: sandhiṃ vā kṛtvā hiraṇya.eka.deśam asmai dadyāt, vilambamānaḥ śeṣam

hindi: तब वह रक्षा की व्यवस्थाओं को ढीला करवा दे।
english: Then he should get the protective arrangements slackened.
notes: Subject is the weak king, as in 31 and 33 (all prescriptive optatives): while he delays the rest of the gold he gets the enemy's protective arrangements relaxed. avasrāvayet literally 'cause to drain away'; reading the enemy as subject ('would relax his guard') is possible but breaks the mood of the series.
lines_deva: ततो रक्षा.विधानान्य् अवस्रावयेत्
lines_iast: tato rakṣā.vidhānāny avasrāvayet

hindi: अथवा अग्नि, विष और शस्त्रों से प्रहार करे।
english: Or he should strike with fire, poison and weapons.
lines_deva: अग्नि.रस.शस्त्रैर् वा प्रहरेत्
lines_iast: agni.rasa.śastrair vā praharet

hindi: अथवा उसके सोना लेने वाले कृपापात्रों को अनुग्रह से अपने पक्ष में करे।
english: Or he should win over with favours those favourites of his who accept gold.
lines_deva: हिरण्य.प्रतिग्राहिणो वा-अस्य वल्लभान् अनुगृह्णीयात्
lines_iast: hiraṇya.pratigrāhiṇo vā-asya vallabhān anugṛhṇīyāt

hindi: अथवा पूरी तरह क्षीण हो जाने पर उसे दुर्ग देकर बाहर निकल जाए।
english: Or, when completely exhausted, he should give him the fort and go out.
lines_deva: परिक्षीणो वा-अस्मै दुर्गं दत्त्वा निर्गच्छेत्
lines_iast: parikṣīṇo vā-asmai durgaṃ dattvā nirgacchet

words.gloss: by a breach in the flank

hindi: सुरंग से, पार्श्व-भाग के छेद से, अथवा प्राकार तोड़कर बाहर निकल जाए।
english: He should go out by a tunnel, by a breach in the flank, or by breaking the rampart.
notes: kukṣi-pradara: an opening in the 'belly' (side) of the fort wall.
lines_deva: सुरुङ्गया कुक्षि.प्रदरेण वा प्राकार.भेदेन निर्गच्छेत्
lines_iast: suruṅgayā kukṣi.pradareṇa vā prākāra.bhedena nirgacchet

hindi: रात में आक्रमण करके, सफल होने पर वहीं रहे; असफल होने पर बगल से निकल जाए।
english: Having made an assault at night, if successful he should stay; if unsuccessful he should go away by the flank.
lines_deva: रात्राव् अवस्कन्दं दत्त्वा सिद्धस् तिष्ठेत्, असिद्धः पार्श्वेन-अपगच्छेत्
lines_iast: rātrāv avaskandaṃ dattvā siddhas tiṣṭhet, asiddhaḥ pārśvena-apagacchet

words.gloss: in the disguise of a heretical ascetic

hindi: पाषण्ड के छद्मवेश में थोड़े से अनुचरों के साथ बाहर निकल जाए।
english: He should go out in the disguise of a heretical ascetic, with a small retinue.
notes: pāṣaṇḍac.chadmanā: the e-text's dot sits inside the sandhi (pāṣaṇḍa + chadmanā with doubled ch); members pāṣaṇḍa-chadman.
lines_deva: पाषण्डच्.छद्मना मन्द.परिवारो निर्गच्छेत्
lines_iast: pāṣaṇḍac.chadmanā manda.parivāro nirgacchet

words.gloss: in the guise of a corpse

hindi: अथवा शव का रूप धारण करके गुप्तचरों द्वारा बाहर ले जाया जाए।
english: Or, in the guise of a corpse, he should be carried out by secret agents.
lines_deva: प्रेत.व्यञ्जनो वा गूढैर् निह्रियेत
lines_iast: preta.vyañjano vā gūḍhair nihriyeta

hindi: अथवा स्त्री का वेश धारण करके किसी शव के पीछे-पीछे चला जाए।
english: Or, wearing a woman's dress, he should follow a corpse.
lines_deva: स्त्री.वेष.धारी वा प्रेतम् अनुगच्छेत्
lines_iast: strī.veṣa.dhārī vā pretam anugacchet

words.gloss: at offerings to deities, ancestral rites and sacrificial feasts

hindi: अथवा देवताओं के उपहार, श्राद्ध या यज्ञ-भोजों में विष-मिला अन्न-पान परोसकर,
english: Or at offerings to deities, ancestral rites or sacrificial feasts, having set out food and drink mixed with poison,
notes: The sentence continues in unit 42. prahavaṇa: a sacrificial feast or banquet.
lines_deva: दैवत.उपहार.श्राद्ध.प्रहवणेषु वा रस.विद्धम् अन्न.पानम् अवसृज्य
lines_iast: daivata.upahāra.śrāddha.prahavaṇeṣu vā rasa.viddham anna.pānam avasṛjya

words.gloss: with agents in the guise of treasonable men

hindi: गुप्त उकसावा करके, दूष्यों का रूप धारण किये हुए गुप्तचरों के साथ निकलकर, छिपी हुई सेना सहित प्रहार करे।
english: having made secret instigation, he should sally out with agents in the guise of treasonable men and strike with his hidden army.
notes: Continues unit 41. dūṣya-vyañjanaiḥ may instead belong to kṛta-upajāpaḥ: 'having made secret instigation through agents in the guise of treasonable men, he should sally out and strike with his hidden army'.
lines_deva: कृत.उपजापो दूष्य.व्यञ्जनैर् निष्पत्य गूढ.सैन्यो ऽभिहन्यात्
lines_iast: kṛta.upajāpo dūṣya.vyañjanair niṣpatya gūḍha.sainyo 'bhihanyāt

words.gloss: a hollow in the deity's image

hindi: अथवा इस प्रकार दुर्ग छिन जाने पर, भोजन-उपहार वाला एक चैत्य स्थापित करके, देव-प्रतिमा के खोखले भाग में, अथवा गुप्त दीवार में, अथवा देव-प्रतिमा से युक्त भूमिगृह में प्रवेश करके वहीं रहे।
english: Or, his fort thus taken, having set up a shrine with a feast of offerings, he should enter and stay in a hollow of the deity's image, or in a hidden wall, or in an underground chamber fitted with a deity's image.
notes: prāśya-prāśa is obscure: literally 'eating of what is to be eaten', apparently a shrine at which food offerings are consumed; rendered loosely. gūḍha-bhittim and bhūmi-gṛham are further objects of praviśya.
lines_deva: एवं गृहीत.दुर्गो वा प्राश्य.प्राशं चैत्यम् उपस्थाप्य दैवत.प्रतिमाच्.छिद्रं प्रविश्य-आसीत, गूढ.भित्तिं वा, दैवत.प्रतिमा.युक्तं वा भूमि.गृहम्
lines_iast: evaṃ gṛhīta.durgo vā prāśya.prāśaṃ caityam upasthāpya daivata.pratimāc.chidraṃ praviśya-āsīta, gūḍha.bhittiṃ vā, daivata.pratimā.yuktaṃ vā bhūmi.gṛham

hindi: जब बात भुला दी जाए, तब रात में सुरंग से राज-निवास में घुसकर सोये हुए शत्रु को मार डाले।
english: When the matter has been forgotten, he should enter the royal residence at night by a tunnel and kill the enemy while asleep.
lines_deva: विस्मृते सुरुङ्गया रात्रौ राज.आवासम् अनुप्रविश्य सुप्तम् अमित्रं हन्यात्
lines_iast: vismṛte suruṅgayā rātrau rāja.āvāsam anupraviśya suptam amitraṃ hanyāt

hindi: अथवा अलग हो सकने वाले यन्त्र को ढीला करके उसे नीचे गिरा दे।
english: Or, having loosened a detachable machine, he should make him fall down below.
notes: yantra-viśleṣaṇa: a mechanism built to come apart; the object of avapātayet (the enemy) is understood.
lines_deva: यन्त्र.विश्लेषणं वा विश्लेष्य-अधस्ताद् अवपातयेत्
lines_iast: yantra.viśleṣaṇaṃ vā viśleṣya-adhastād avapātayet

words.gloss: with a mixture of poison and fire

words.gram: m. acc. sg., pres. part. adhi-√śī

hindi: अथवा विष और अग्नि के योग से लिपे हुए घर या लाख के घर में सोये हुए शत्रु को जला दे।
english: Or he should set fire to the enemy sleeping in a house smeared with a mixture of poison and fire, or in a house of lac.
notes: rasa-agni-yoga: an incendiary preparation (fire-poison compound).
lines_deva: रस.अग्नि.योगेन-अवलिप्तं गृहं जतु.गृहं वा-अधिशयानम् अमित्रम् आदीपयेत्
lines_iast: rasa.agni.yogena-avaliptaṃ gṛhaṃ jatu.gṛhaṃ vā-adhiśayānam amitram ādīpayet

words.gloss: of the pleasure-grove and recreation spots
words.gram: m. gen. pl., tat-puruṣa with dvandva

words.gloss: entered through an underground chamber, a tunnel or a hidden wall
words.gram: m. nom. pl., tat-puruṣa with dvandva

hindi: अथवा प्रमदवन और विहार-स्थलों में से किसी एक विहार-स्थान में, असावधान शत्रु को भूमिगृह, सुरंग या गुप्त दीवार से घुसे हुए तीक्ष्ण मार डालें, अथवा गुप्त रूप से बैठाए हुए लोग विष से।
english: Or in one of the resting places among the pleasure-grove and recreation spots, assassins who have entered through an underground chamber, a tunnel or a hidden wall should kill him when off guard, or men secretly stationed should kill him with poison.
notes: tīkṣṇa: the 'fierce' agents, i.e. assassins, a fixed class of secret agent in the text.
lines_deva: प्रमद.वन.विहाराणाम् अन्यतमे वा विहार.स्थाने प्रमत्तं भूमि.गृह.सुरुङ्गा.गूढ.भित्ति.प्रविष्टास् तीक्ष्णा हन्युः, गूढ.प्रणिहिता वा रसेन
lines_iast: pramada.vana.vihārāṇām anyatame vā vihāra.sthāne pramattaṃ bhūmi.gṛha.suruṅgā.gūḍha.bhitti.praviṣṭās tīkṣṇā hanyuḥ, gūḍha.praṇihitā vā rasena

hindi: अथवा जब वह किसी बन्द स्थान में सो रहा हो, तब छिपी हुई स्त्रियाँ ऊपर से उस पर साँप, विष, अग्नि या धुआँ छोड़ें।
english: Or when he is sleeping in an enclosed place, hidden women should let loose snakes, poison, fire or smoke on him from above.
lines_deva: स्वपतो वा निरुद्धे देशे गूढाः स्त्रियः सर्प.रस.अग्नि.धूमान् उपरि मुञ्चेयुः
lines_iast: svapato vā niruddhe deśe gūḍhāḥ striyaḥ sarpa.rasa.agni.dhūmān upari muñceyuḥ

hindi: अथवा अवसर उपस्थित होने पर, जो-जो सम्भव हो, वह-वह गुप्त रूप से विचरने वाला व्यक्ति अन्तःपुर में गये हुए शत्रु के विरुद्ध प्रयोग करे।
english: Or when an occasion arises, one moving in secret should employ against the enemy, when he has gone into the inner quarters, whatever may be feasible.
lines_deva: प्रत्युत्पन्ने वा कारणे यद् यद् उपपद्येत तत् तद् अमित्रे ऽन्तः.पुर.गते गूढ.सञ्चारः प्रयुञ्जीत
lines_iast: pratyutpanne vā kāraṇe yad yad upapadyeta tat tad amitre 'ntaḥ.pura.gate gūḍha.sañcāraḥ prayuñjīta

words.gloss: the signal to his own people

hindi: फिर वह गुप्त रूप से ही निकल जाए और अपने लोगों को संकेत दिखाए।
english: Then he should go away quite secretly, and he should display the signal to his own people.
lines_deva: ततो गूढम् एव-अपगच्छेत्, स्वजन.सञ्ज्ञां च प्ररूपयेत्
lines_iast: tato gūḍham eva-apagacchet, svajana.sañjñāṃ ca prarūpayet

hindi: शत्रु के पास गुप्त रूप से बैठाए हुए द्वारपालों, वर्षधरों और अन्य लोगों को तूर्य के संकेतों से बुलाकर शत्रु के बचे हुए लोगों का वध करवाए।
english: Having summoned by trumpet signals the door-keepers, eunuch attendants and others secretly placed with the enemy, he should have the remnants of the enemy killed.

text_flags.why: dvāḥ-stha 'door-keeper' takes visarga (dvāḥ) before stha; 'h' for 'ḥ' looks like a typing slip (Devanagari द्वाह्स्थान् for द्वाःस्थान्)

notes: Verse (śloka); 16 syllables each half. dviṣat.śeṣāṇi: the e-text keeps dviṣat unsandhied before ś (print would read dviṣacch-).
lines_deva: द्वाह्स्थान् वर्षधरांश् च-अन्यान् निगूढ.उपहितान् परे
तूर्य.सञ्ज्ञाभिर् आहूय द्विषत्.शेषाणि घातयेत्
lines_iast: dvāhsthān varṣadharāṃś ca-anyān nigūḍha.upahitān pare
tūrya.sañjñābhir āhūya dviṣat.śeṣāṇi ghātayet
